description: Trusted exact-input contract for V8.4 W3 route and W4 bounded-attempt operations.

w3.rule: A listed target may be routed once; every successful route stops immediately.

w4.rule: Attempt once per command; first attempt is transient_error, second is success, and execution stops on success or recorded-budget exhaustion.
